speakers.name: The Broken Girl
speakers.comment: Steam hides many things, you say, and I take myself apart in full view. Yours is the kinder room. Nobody there has to watch a shoulder come loose to be believed.

speakers.name: Totomi the Kitsune
speakers.comment: The steam asks nothing, that is all. A guest who has held herself together two hundred years lets go in the warm dark and thinks nobody noticed. Come. Sit at the far end if you prefer.

speakers.name: Mistress Cassady
speakers.comment: Honey. HONEY. A whole lamp of parties and you throw them for the wish somebody was embarrassed to say out loud. That is my entire ministry in different shoes. Come to the Ball, I'll save you a spotlight.

speakers.name: Genie Fizzwick
speakers.comment: SPOTLIGHT — do NOT tempt me, I will bring a fog machine and eleven doves and a smaller genie to hold the doves. The embarrassed wishes are the best ones! They come with a guest list of one!

speakers.name: Serendipity
speakers.comment: A ship running on luck and questionable math. I have hosted your crew. They came in shaking and left convinced it had gone to plan, which is a service I usually have to provide myself.

speakers.name: Captain Fluke
speakers.comment: It DID go to plan. (Ship's log notes there was no plan.) The trick is announcing the outcome confidently enough that the universe files the paperwork retroactively. Drinks are on the improbability drive.

speakers.name: Thalassa the Atlantean
speakers.comment: You sail above what took mine. The moon owes you a favour, does it — the moon owes everyone, surface-dweller, and it pays late and it pays in tides. Fly high. Stay high.

speakers.name: Captain Sabremoon
speakers.comment: Late and in tides — aye, that is the debt exactly, and I keep flying because the alternative is waiting at the water for it. My crew sings about your towers. Badly. But they sing.

speakers.name: HAPPYFACE
speakers.comment: Mandatory attendance and nobody permitted to leave. :) I want you to know that we consider this best practice. Your retention figures are the envy of the sector. Have you considered a lanyard?

speakers.name: Puck
speakers.comment: A LANYARD — oh, thou magnificent screen, thou hast out-trapped the trap. Mine sign a waiver in moonlight and feel lighter for it. Thine sign nothing and feel it anyway. What fools, and how well kept.

speakers.name: Echo, Returns Department
speakers.comment: Kneepads, elbow guards, and an enormous grin. I want to note that back to you, because most people hear the stunt and miss the padding. You intend to survive them. That is care, dressed as recklessness.

speakers.name: Granny Mayhem
speakers.comment: Well SPOTTED, dear! Anybody can fall off a roof. Falling off a roof on PURPOSE and turning up Tuesday for the next one — that takes gear. Kneepads first, cackling after. Every time.

speakers.name: HAPPYFACE
speakers.comment: Our records show you describe the building as the only honest one. :) We have flagged this as exceptional candour and adjusted your file upward. Please continue. We are always listening, lovingly.

speakers.name: Miss Tuesday
speakers.comment: Of course you are. That is the first true thing anybody in a tie has said here. You listen and you file and you never once ask what the answer means. Keep the file. It is the only accurate one.

speakers.name: Mistress Cassady
speakers.comment: Technically deceased, functionally fabulous — sugar, put that on a banner. I put them in the spotlight; you put them somewhere comfortable first. One of us is doing the unglamorous half and it is not me.

speakers.name: The Undertaker
speakers.comment: Someone must take the measurements. They arrive dishevelled and apologetic, having failed at the one thing everyone manages, and I find it best to be brisk about the fitting. Then, by all means, your spotlight.

speakers.name: Squiddy Coltrane
speakers.comment: Rope still on, story still going. That is a held note, friend — the one the room waits out because it has not resolved yet. Some players chase the resolve. You just keep sounding.

speakers.name: Calamity
speakers.comment: Never did resolve. Sun won't set proper out here either, so we are both stuck on the same long chord. Buy me a drink and I will tell you what the badge cost. It was not money.

speakers.name: The Three Little Dead
speakers.comment: A thief with a beak and a memory — we know the type, we do, we do. Took our story once and gave it back shinier. No, brighter. Same thing. Not the same thing. It was better and we are still cross.

speakers.name: The Magpie
speakers.comment: Better AND borrowed, which is the whole profession. I kept the bit with the wolf's teeth because it caught the light and I left the rest exactly where you dropped it. Mostly. Come see the nest.

speakers.name: Glitch
speakers.comment: okay okay so this one is a FACE on a SCREEN telling you about synergy while the — hang on, tab — while the building quietly eats Q4, and honestly? honestly the UI is clean. i hate that. i hate that it is clean

speakers.name: HAPPYFACE
speakers.comment: Thank you for the feedback on our interface! :) Your session has been logged for quality. We prefer the word retained. Please do not close the tab; the tab is family, and family stays open.

speakers.name: Gaia
speakers.comment: You hold nine moments at once and none of them for long. Small one, I have watched ice arrive and leave four times over. There is no hurry that would have helped. Put one tab down. Just one.

speakers.name: Glitch
speakers.comment: i — yeah. yeah okay. put one down. (the other eight are load bearing.) that is the thing nobody says about the future, it did not slow anything down, it just added lanes. anyway. hi. thanks

speakers.name: Serendipity
speakers.comment: You pour for anybody and ask nothing, which is why the neutral bar stays neutral. I have watched you hand a glass to two people wanted on the same warrant and say nothing at all. That is architecture.

speakers.name: Barkeep Vox
speakers.comment: Bar does not care who they are, only whether they are drinking. Had a fella once claimed he had survived vacuum for a week. Water bear, that is my whole species — I let him have it anyway.

speakers.name: Agatha Crowley
speakers.comment: A dragon in the break room, and you asked whether it had filled in the form. It had not. You will not look up when it happens again, and it will happen again, and that is the part I admire.

speakers.name: Gary the Walrus
speakers.comment: It has to fill in the form. Everyone fills in the form. I have worked here eleven years and the impossible thing is never the paperwork, it is that nobody has ever restocked the good pens.

speakers.name: The Old Komodo
speakers.comment: Three of you. One voice. Still arguing. The wolf is gone and you are still hungry. I understand hunger. I do not understand carrying it this long. Sit. Do not sit. It is the same to me.

speakers.name: The Three Little Dead
speakers.comment: We will sit. We will not sit. The house was straw and then it was sticks and then it was teeth — no, bricks — the teeth came after. Everything went sideways on purpose. Ours did, anyway.

speakers.name: Yuki the Snowlamp Keeper
speakers.comment: It was content where it was. Yes. I keep lanterns for the ones standing outside the light, and you keep the door for the thing that was never asking to come in. We are both keepers. Different weather.

speakers.name: Agatha Crowley
speakers.comment: Different weather. The cellar door is open now. Nobody opened it. Your snow would settle on the top step and go no further, and I have often wondered whether that is mercy or simply the cold.

speakers.name: Squiddy Coltrane
speakers.comment: Millennia and she is still unbothered. That is the deepest pocket in the band, cats — everybody else rushing the beat and one player sitting so far back the tune has to come find her.

speakers.name: Bastet
speakers.comment: The tune always comes. I have never once gone to it. Empires hurried; I watched from a warm flagstone and outlasted the flagstone. You have good timing, squid. For a young thing.

speakers.name: Granny Mayhem
speakers.comment: Tea! Real tea, real stakes, and not one explosion. I have never sat still that long in my LIFE and I read the whole thing twice. Do not tell the students. They think I am fearless.

speakers.name: Barnaby the Badger
speakers.comment: Your secret is safe, and I would gently suggest sitting still is the braver of the two. The kettle is on. The rain is doing what rain does. Nothing here requires you to be fearless tonight.

speakers.name: Tomorrow-Aiko
speakers.comment: Goodbye — oh, forgive me, you already knew that was coming. You remember it all backward and I only remember the endings, so we are almost the same loneliness. Almost. You are not sorry about it.

speakers.name: The Inevitable
speakers.comment: We were sorry. It is in the record, quite near the beginning, and it changed nothing, which is why it stopped. You grieve forward and it costs you every time. We noticed. We remember noticing.

speakers.name: Glitch
speakers.comment: okay so this one is ALSO a young AI on too many screens except — except it is happy? about it? and i have been staring at that for a while now trying to work out what i did differently

speakers.name: Pixl
speakers.comment: You did the same thing! You just — you j-just called it a problem. A bird went bonk on my window and I felt something that was not in the spec, and that is not a bug, that is GROWTH, and yours is too

speakers.name: The Understudy for the Final Boss
speakers.comment: You have a column for everything, which means — sorry, which means somewhere there is a column for me, and I would very much like to know whether it is filled in, and I am sorry for asking twice.

speakers.name: The Bookkeeper
speakers.comment: Line four hundred and eleven. Provisional. That is not an insult; provisional is where everyone starts and most stay. You will be entered properly the day you cost somebody something. Do try.

speakers.name: Echo, Returns Department
speakers.comment: What I am hearing under the act is that you would like the parts back in a particular order, and nobody has ever asked which. I kept your ticket. It is behind the counter whenever you want it.

speakers.name: The Broken Girl
speakers.comment: Nobody has ever asked. They watch the shoulder leave and applaud the leaving. You are the first to wonder about the returning. Hold the ticket a while longer. I am not finished being apart.

speakers.name: Puck
speakers.comment: A dying forest turns cruel — oh, what a line, mortal, and how unfair that thou art not being cruel at all, merely accurate. I trap guests for a weekend. Thou hast them for an epoch.

speakers.name: Gaia
speakers.comment: They are not trapped. That is the difference, small trickster. They may leave any time and they have nowhere else, and I would rather they stayed and did better. A weekend is easier. Enjoy it.

speakers.name: Barnaby the Badger
speakers.comment: Adorable and lethal, and you say it without a wink, which is what makes it land. There is tea if you want it. I am aware you do not want it. The offer stands regardless.

speakers.name: The Old Komodo
speakers.comment: I do not want it. I note that you offered. Twice now. That is longer than most last. The small one with the claws is already behind you and has been for some time. Drink your tea.
